text:
Ava (eng): Morning async: what I did - landed a schema tweak for quota checks, fixed the staging leak test. Blockers - seeing two slow tail lat spikes when batching threshold > 8; suspect kv-cache eviction timing. Today - instrument eviction metrics, raise PR for a small backoff, and prep canary instructions.

Rohan (product): Quick question: will the canary need a customer-visible release note? If it's internal perf only, we can skip external comms.

Ava (eng): @Rohan it's internal perf/ops only. I'll include a short blurb for the status page in case we need rollback comms.

Maya (eng-sre): Observability note: added a temporary dashboard for eviction_count and batch_latency. Also tied an alert rule at p95>250ms for us-east-1.

Liam (design): Heads-up: I'll be reworking the onboarding banner to mention dedicated capacity options. Dropped drafts in Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd/onboard-banner

Jordan (eng): PR #4391 needs a second review for the scheduler refactor. It's small, but blocks perf tests. Anyone with time?

Ava (eng): tagging to review @Jordan after I push the instrumentation. ETA 2-3 hours.

Rohan (product): Two asks for the morning: (1) who can review Dedicated pricing copy? (2) volunteer to run a 7-min demo of autoscale in next all-hands. React with :thumbsup: if available.

Maya (eng-sre): I can demo autoscale and walk through last week's incident timeline.

Finance-Bot: Reminder - Dedicated capacity invoice APR-2026 processed. Contact procurement for disputes.

Ava (eng): Blocker update: repro'd the tail spike locally with a harness; root cause is a race when multiple batches evict the same KV before warmup completes. Working on a coord lock and adding a test.

Rohan (product): Cool. Ping me when PR is up so I can schedule the feature-flag flip and update internal release notes.

Liam (design): Reminder: product needs demo slides by Tuesday EOD to polish visuals.

Ava (eng): Noted. Also OOO Thurs afternoon; if the canary needs rollback please page @Maya.

Maya (eng-sre): noted. I'll babysit the canary monitors tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

Jordan (eng): tiny follow-up - if you review PR #4391, leave comments as suggestions to keep the diff small.

Ava (eng): will do. Thanks team!
